land.text: 'located in the Ganges-Yamuna Doab of the Upper Gangetic plain', 'the modern-day areas of Rohilkhand', Kannauj and Kanpur, 'the Central Ganga-Yamuna Doab in Uttar Pradesh', 'to the west of the Gomti River, and the north of the Chambal River' (Panchala page); the same country as the janapada-of-pancala dossier (sa-01-c)

successors.note: Same state: the page has the Panchala an 'oligarchic confederacy' by the 5th century and republican 'around 500 BCE'; the Mahajanapada row of Cliopatria (sa-01-c dossier) begins in -600. One hue for the pair (rule 2).

capitals.name: Ahichchhatra (northern Panchala, Ramnagar near Bareilly)
capitals.note: The page names 'Ahichchhatra' as the capital of northern Panchala and 'Kampilya' as the capital of southern Panchala; the Mahabharata puts the capital at Kanyakubja (Kannauj). No years are given. Coordinates are the site's (the page gives none).

capitals.name: Kampilya (southern Panchala, Kampil)
capitals.note: Capital of southern Panchala on the page; concurrent with Ahichchhatra, not successive.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Vedic Panchala; its Janapada of Pancala row begins in -600). The page gives no area; the shape resolves to about 45,500 km2 from the districts the page names (Rohilkhand, Kannauj, Kanpur, the central Ganga-Yamuna Doab), the same country as the sa-01-c dossier.

region.text: 'located in the Ganges-Yamuna Doab of the Upper Gangetic plain', 'the modern-day areas of Rohilkhand', Kannauj and Kanpur, 'the Central Ganga-Yamuna Doab in Uttar Pradesh', 'to the west of the Gomti River, and the north of the Chambal River' (Panchala page); the same country as the janapada-of-pancala dossier (sa-01-c)

ledger.note: c. 1100 BCE: Panchala stands in the Ganges-Yamuna Doab. 'During Late Vedic times (c. 1100-500 BCE)' it was 'one of the most powerful states of ancient India'; infobox 'c. 1100 BCE - c. 340 BCE'; the Shatapatha Brahmana makes it 'the later name of the Krivi tribe'. The page's other infobox years (c. 850, c. 750) are garbled. The year is the page's c. 1100; the country is the page's districts.

region.text: 'located in the Ganges-Yamuna Doab of the Upper Gangetic plain', 'the modern-day areas of Rohilkhand', Kannauj and Kanpur, 'the Central Ganga-Yamuna Doab in Uttar Pradesh', 'to the west of the Gomti River, and the north of the Chambal River' (Panchala page); the same country as the janapada-of-pancala dossier (sa-01-c)

ledger.note: c. 600 BCE: the Panchala monarchy becomes the Mahajanapada of Panchala. 'By the c. 5th century BCE, it had become an oligarchic confederacy' and 'the Panchalas appear to have switched to a republican model of government around 500 BCE'; the Mahajanapadas page (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mahajanapadas) has the switch 'in the 6th and 5th centuries BCE'. -601 is the year before the Mahajanapada convention year (-600), not a date on either page.

certainty.note: A Vedic kingdom known from texts; the page gives districts, rivers and forests, not frontiers ('separated from the Ganga and the Kurus by dense forests').

sources.title: Panchala kingdom
sources.note: Late Vedic c. 1100-500, Kesin Dalbhya 'approximately between 900 and 750 BCE', capitals Ahichchhatra and Kampilya, the Rohilkhand and Doab extent, republic around 500 BCE, Nanda annexation in the mid-4th century.

sources.title: Mahajanapadas
sources.note: Panchala 'to the east of the Kurus between the mountains and river Ganges'; the switch to a republican corporation in the 6th-5th centuries BCE.

notes: Written from the group scope's 'Vedic janapadas before 600 BCE'; sa-01-c's janapada-of-pancala starts in -600 and lists no predecessor, so it should name panchala-kingdom. Overlap: the Painted Grey Ware culture (this batch) covers Ahichchhatra and Kampil; the Panchala page does not mention it. The page's Kuru-Panchala alliance and Kesin Dalbhya ('ruled approximately between 900 and 750 BCE', took over after the Kuru king died heirless) move no land on the page, so no gain is written. The page's infobox has c. 1100 BCE to c. 340 BCE with garbled intermediate years; the post-600 life is the sa-01-c dossier's. Gazetteer: Ahichchhatra and Kampilya are not places.
